 .;the IRT Update Std. Defic. option or IRT Update Std. Def. Background Job
 .;options. Depending on the error encountered, it sends patient information
 .;for manual review.
 .

 .;If errors were encountered, this routine builds and sends an email
 .;detailing the errors and prompting the user to manually run the IRT
 .;Update Std. Defic. option for the listed patients.
 .
dca2dc69: ;Loop through errors by movement date
aa473a33: ;Build error message text for this patient/movement
8440f468: ;Set message text array for mail message
fd6aed12: ;Get mail group for errors from DD

5d0bc952: ;Send mail message if there are recipients

5bb8fae2:  ;
 ;If an error is encountered during the Incomplete Records
 ;menu run, this code generates an email message with the
 ;details of the error(s) and sends it to the email group
 ;specified in the PARAMETERS file (#43).
 ;
 ;The message includes the patient name, last 4 digits of
 ;SSN, movement date and time, and a description of the
 ;error encountered.
